script:
control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$CID/events" --json "[\"$E2\"]" --expect 200 --check . len-eq 1 --check 0.id eq "$E2" --save F06.unknown-event-batch/known-control
control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$CID/events" --json "[\"$E2\",\"qa-missing-event\"]" --expect 200 --check . len-eq 2 --check 0.id eq "$E2" --check 1 missing --save F06.unknown-event-batch/mixed  # bug
